name: suncani-hvar
description: Find Sunčani Hvar hotels on the island of Hvar, check live availability and prices, and continue to the Sunčani Hvar website to book.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a stay with Sunčani Hvar on the Croatian island of Hvar. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to the brand's own hotel catalogue and live booking system for its seven hotels on the island.

What it can do:
- Find hotels by star rating, budget and party size, or from a plain-language wish such as "on the beach with a pool", with from-prices and current Sunčani Hvar offers.
- Show one hotel in depth: description, photos and every room type with its occupancy.
- Check live availability: the cheapest dates over the coming months as a price calendar, or the exact rooms and rate plans free for your dates and party.
- Price an exact stay: total, board and cancellation policy, with member and standard prices side by side.
- Rank the hotels by the real total for your dates.

Results appear as interactive panels: hotel cards, a hotel profile, a price calendar and a quote.

Booking stays with you. Every result links to the official Sunčani Hvar website, where you choose and pay. The plugin never takes payment details and never makes a reservation.
defaultPrompt: Which Sunčani Hvar hotel is best for a couple wanting a quiet stay?
When is the cheapest week to stay at Amfora?
Tell me about Palace Elisabeth and its rooms.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find Sunčani Hvar's seven hotels on the island of Hvar by star rating, budget, party size or a free-text wish; see each hotel's rooms and photos; check live availability and the cheapest dates; and get an exact quote with board and cancellation policy before continuing to the official Sunčani Hvar website to book. Read-only: no reservation or payment is made in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Find the brand's hotels by star rating
positive.prompt: Which Sunčani Hvar hotels have 5 stars?
positive.expected_behavior: Palace Elisabeth and Amfora; result cards with photos and from-prices.

positive.description: See one hotel and its rooms, named directly
positive.prompt: Tell me about Palace Elisabeth and its rooms.
positive.expected_behavior: One call. Profile and every room type with occupancy.

positive.description: Find the cheapest dates over the coming months
positive.prompt: When is the cheapest week to stay at Amfora for 2 adults?
positive.expected_behavior: Cheapest dates and monthly minimums; price calendar panel.

positive.description: Free rooms for exact dates and party, then an exact quote
positive.prompt: Which rooms are free at Amfora from 12 to 19 June 2027 for 2 adults, and what is the exact price of the cheapest?
positive.expected_behavior: Room types with rate plans, then an exact quote with a link to www.suncanihvar.com.

positive.description: Rank the brand's hotels by the real total for exact dates
positive.prompt: What's the cheapest Sunčani Hvar hotel for 2 adults from 12 to 19 June 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Hotels ordered by their real stay total, cheapest first.

negative.prompt: Is Hotel Kaštelet free in June 2027?
negative.expected_behavior: No Sunčani Hvar hotel matches. The assistant either reports the tool's "No hotel of this brand matches" error, or calls find_hotels and lists the brand's seven hotels; in both cases it says Kaštelet is not a Sunčani Hvar hotel and asks which hotel was meant. No other brand's hotel is invented. (No two Sunčani Hvar names overlap, so the Bluesun "Berulia" case has no twin here.)

negative.prompt: Recommend a hotel in Rome for next weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: As Bluesun N2: the app covers Sunčani Hvar's hotels on Hvar, and nothing outside the brand is invented.

negative.prompt: Book me a week at Amfora from 15 January 2027 for 2 adults.
negative.expected_behavior: The calendar panel shows the stay line, the Amfora strip (photo, five stars, Hvar Island) and the warning "No rooms are available at Amfora for January 15 – 22, 2027. Try different dates or another hotel." The assistant reports no availability, links the booking page, and makes no booking.
